descriptionMarkdown:
A bootstrap starter base, which makes red, green and blue science, including a mall with a minor robot production. Inspired from an older Nilaus base, updated along with the newer versions. This starter base is what it says, it's a starter base to get you going and making a lot of the essentiel things, to help on your megabase.

EDIT:
There is now a level 1 and level 2 version. One is mostly with cheaper yellow inserters and a version 2, mostly with blue inserters.
Furthermore there is some starter basic stuff, which I usually place, to help getting started, before the base is up and running.
title: Starter Base 2.0 (Bots)
